def: to leave under (behind), i.e. (passively) to remain (survive)

occurrences.text: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
